reviews.body:
Thanks @pcbeingused333, nice catch on the nil `Content`. Both helpers guard it, the citations still come after the text, and your note on the SDKs checks out: generative-ai-go turns safety and recitation stops into errors first, Vertex does that for safety only, so the recitation case in your Vertex test is real. CI is green at `8bb7bb7`.

Good to merge
